name: Noyan Dar
description: Noyan Dar is a merfolk roilmage who runs a retreat at Coralhelm and leads the roilmages in Gideon's army against the Eldrazi on Zendikar.

summary.text: Noyan Dar is a merfolk roilmage who runs a retreat at Coralhelm and leads the roilmages in Gideon's army against the Eldrazi on Zendikar.

bio.text: Noyan leads initiates at Coralhelm in a litany meant to teach them to heighten the Roil, and when Gideon asks for help at Sea Gate he insists on a practical demonstration.

citations.text: "Shaping an Army" by Ken Troop. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 21 Oct 2015.

timeline.summary: Sea Gate and the Enclave fall to the Eldrazi spawn and Noyan Dar leads refugees upriver to found Coralhelm Refuge.
timeline.quote: he led refugees from the Enclave farther upriver to found Coralhelm Refuge

citation.text: "Noyan Dar", section "History". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0, MTG Wiki contributors.

timeline.summary: Gideon Jura visits Noyan Dar, flatters him, and wins his agreement to join the army.
timeline.quote: agreed to join Gideon's army

citation.text: "Noyan Dar", section "History". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0, MTG Wiki contributors.

timeline.summary: Noyan Dar realizes Gideon tricked him as Cosi tricked Ula.
timeline.quote: Gideon had tricked him just as Cosi tricked Ula

citation.text: "Noyan Dar", section "History". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0, MTG Wiki contributors.

timeline.summary: Noyan Dar and his students take part in the Liberation of Sea Gate and drive off Ulamog's brood.
timeline.quote: helped in driving off Ulamog 's brood

citation.text: "Noyan Dar", section "History". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0, MTG Wiki contributors.

timeline.summary: After Kozilek's awakening Noyan Dar is the last roil mage standing and survives Zendikar's Last Stand.
timeline.quote: Dar was the last roil mage standing

citation.text: "Noyan Dar", section "History". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0, MTG Wiki contributors.

timeline.summary: Gideon manipulates Noyan Dar into joining the retaking of Sea Gate by exploiting his hubris.
timeline.quote: Gideon had used his hubris against him as manipulation to get him to offer his help

citation.text: "Gideon Jura", section "The Battle for Zendikar". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0, MTG Wiki contributors.

timeline.summary: Saved by her halo, Tazri regroups with Noyan Dar, Drana and Munda and takes command, leading to Chandra's arrival.
timeline.quote: inspired by the angel she had killed so long ago, took command.

citation.text: "Tazri", section "The Battle for Zendikar". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0, MTG Wiki contributors.

timeline.summary: Noyan Dar leads his initiates at Coralhelm in a deliberately dissonant litany meant to teach them to heighten the Roil.
timeline.quote: "Balance is death!"

citation.text: "Shaping an Army" by Ken Troop. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 21 Oct 2015.

timeline.summary: A kitesailer's harness shears off in an updraft and his passenger falls hundreds of feet.
timeline.quote: his passenger plummeted to the ground hundreds of feet below.

citation.text: "Shaping an Army" by Ken Troop. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 21 Oct 2015.

timeline.summary: The falling man survives the impact in a flash of golden light and introduces himself as Gideon Jura, looking for Noyan.
timeline.quote: I'm Gideon Jura. I'm looking for the roilmage, Noyan Dar.

citation.text: "Shaping an Army" by Ken Troop. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 21 Oct 2015.

timeline.summary: Gideon asks for the roilmages' help at Sea Gate; Noyan objects that they are not elementalists and are in training.
timeline.quote: We need your help at Sea Gate.

citation.text: "Shaping an Army" by Ken Troop. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 21 Oct 2015.

timeline.summary: Noyan explains through the story of Ula and the sneeze that the Roil is the world's natural defense against the Eldrazi.
timeline.quote: The Roil built up over time as a natural defense against the presence of the Eldrazi.

citation.text: "Shaping an Army" by Ken Troop. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 21 Oct 2015.

timeline.summary: Llura leads the full litany, and Gideon, doubting the roilmages, is moved to say this may not have been a good idea.
timeline.quote: Maybe . . . maybe this was not a good idea,

citation.text: "Shaping an Army" by Ken Troop. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 21 Oct 2015.

timeline.summary: Angered, Noyan insists on a practical demonstration, and the group travels to Tazeem to find an Eldrazi herd.
timeline.quote: "A practical demonstration is in order," Noyan said. "I insist."

citation.text: "Shaping an Army" by Ken Troop. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 21 Oct 2015.

timeline.summary: The Eldrazi swarm toward Gideon and Noyan while the initiates spread in a wide circle.
timeline.quote: The Eldrazi slowly began swarming in the direction of Gideon and Noyan

citation.text: "Shaping an Army" by Ken Troop. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 21 Oct 2015.

timeline.summary: The initiates work the circle while Noyan gathers irritation into the Roil as Gideon holds the Eldrazi at bay.
timeline.quote: the large circle of earth surrounding Gideon and Noyan began to rotate in one direction and then the other.

citation.text: "Shaping an Army" by Ken Troop. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 21 Oct 2015.

timeline.summary: Noyan unleashes the Roil, collapsing the ground into a chasm that kills the Eldrazi horde and drops Gideon with it.
timeline.quote: Noyan cast his spell.

citation.text: "Shaping an Army" by Ken Troop. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 21 Oct 2015.

timeline.summary: Gideon survives the fall, apologizes for his doubt and asks the roilmages to join the defense of Sea Gate.
timeline.quote: I am sorry, Noyan, for any doubt. That display was amazing.

citation.text: "Shaping an Army" by Ken Troop. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 21 Oct 2015.

timeline.summary: Noyan agrees that the roilmages will come to Sea Gate the next day.
timeline.quote: We will be there.

citation.text: "Shaping an Army" by Ken Troop. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 21 Oct 2015.

timeline.summary: Noyan realizes Gideon's last question about Cosi and Ula was a hint that he had been manipulated by his own pride.
timeline.quote: Noyan Dar's elation turned into a very flat stare.

citation.text: "Shaping an Army" by Ken Troop. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 21 Oct 2015.

timeline.summary: The army marches again in organized ranks to the beat of a conch-shell drum, with Noyan Dar's roilmages held back.
timeline.quote: They marched.

citation.text: "The Liberation of Sea Gate" by James Wyatt. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 28 Oct 2015.

timeline.summary: Gideon gathers Drana, Noyan Dar, Tazri, Nissa and Kiora's forces and retakes Sea Gate from the Eldrazi.
timeline.quote: Together, their combined forces managed to wrest Sea Gate away from the Eldrazi invaders.

citation.text: "Battle for Zendikar Story Summary" by Mel Li. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 23 Dec 2015.

timeline.summary: Tazri returns to find her soldiers dead and Kozilek far away, and sees Noyan Dar's roilmages obliterated by reflected fire and earth.
timeline.quote: Tazri didn't have time to shout a warning as the fire and earth swept through the roilmages, obliterating them.

citation.work: The Blight We Were Born For
citation.text: "The Blight We Were Born For" by Ken Troop. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 20 Jan 2016.

timeline.summary: Drana rescues Noyan Dar in mid-air, and Drana's and Munda's troops turn the tide briefly.
timeline.quote: The arrival of Drana's and Munda's troops had temporarily turned the tide of battle.

citation.work: The Blight We Were Born For
citation.text: "The Blight We Were Born For" by Ken Troop. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 20 Jan 2016.

timeline.summary: Tazri assumes command, tells Noyan Dar to open a rift and orders Munda to prepare the troops to flee, leaving the dying behind.
timeline.quote: Munda, prepare the troops. We are getting out of here.

citation.work: The Blight We Were Born For
citation.text: "The Blight We Were Born For" by Ken Troop. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 20 Jan 2016.

timeline.summary: Tazri persuades Drana to follow her as general and to feed energy to Noyan Dar.
timeline.quote: As you command, General Tazri,

citation.work: The Blight We Were Born For
citation.text: "The Blight We Were Born For" by Ken Troop. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 20 Jan 2016.

timeline.summary: Survivors gather in the ash with no celebration, and Kiora leaves with the bident.
timeline.quote: And she didn't stop walking for a long time.

citation.text: "Zendikar's Last Stand" by Doug Beyer. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 24 Feb 2016.

timeline.summary: Noyan Dar turns Vaash away.
timeline.quote: he turned her away

citation.text: "Vaash Vroga", section "Zendikar". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0, MTG Wiki contributors.

timeline.summary: Noyan Dar explains that Vaash duped Thada Adel into trying to restart the Roil.
timeline.quote: He explained that Vaash had duped Thada Adel into thinking she could heal Tazeem by restarting the Roil .

citation.text: "The Traveler", section "Zendikar". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0, MTG Wiki contributors.
